column1: # Phase 14 -- the argparse dests. argparse derives `args.partidas` from the
# flag `--partidas`, so renaming the flag without the attribute is a silent
# AttributeError at run time. The flags moved by hand (they are strings); this
# moves the attributes that read them.
# `rival`, `censo`, `partidas`, `detalle` and friends are also data keys or
# words used elsewhere -- `report` lists every literal and each one was checked.
# `candidato` / `espejo` / `partidas` are keys of the self-play and matchup
# RESULT dicts, which a person reads; they carry `str` so the key moves with
# the attribute. `titulo` is a key of the batch config the extraction tools
# read -- those configs are one-off and are rewritten with the tool.
# `aplicar` and `autopsia` are NOT here: a previous phase had already renamed
# flags stayed Spanish, so those three scripts were broken. Renaming the flags
